_contract: A MATERIAL SCIENTIFIC FINDING, not an engineering defect. It authorizes nothing and changes nothing; it returns a design question to review, per the contract's PART A clause 9.
finding: In bf16 on a real 596M model, a padded batched forward differs from a solo forward by ~4.9e-02 relative on the logits. That is the dtype through 28 layers, not a masking or batching defect: the same comparison in float32 is 9.1e-06.

measurements._kl_partly_cancels: a causal KL compares two forwards under the SAME batch composition, so the perturbation largely cancels: 7.1e-03 against 4.9e-02 raw. An activation STATISTIC has nothing to cancel against.

what_is_NOT_wrong: the batching arithmetic: float32 batched-vs-solo is 9.1e-06
the masking: poisoning padded positions changes per-item KL by exactly 0.0, on CUDA
the KL reducer: max relative drift vs the scalar oracle 1.02e-07 on CUDA, and bit-identical at B=1
the attention statistics or DEPTH on the toy: identical selections and removal order on the L40S
why_it_matters: operators whose output is a dense top-k over activation statistics -- ffn.activation_importance_v0 and attention.activation_importance_v1 -- are not reproducible across micro_batch_size in bf16 on a real model
DEFAULT_MICRO_BATCH_SIZE is currently 4, so a formal run would NOT reproduce the pre-refactor selections, and the C3 fixed prefix's pre-ATTENTION parent digest eea90c91... would not reproduce
C3's own treatment arm is a per-GQA-group top-k, so it has the same exposure

the_conservative_remedy_not_taken_autono.effect: every operator reproduces the pre-refactor numbers bit-for-bit -- batch_size=1 is already proven bit-identical -- so frozen decisions are preserved exactly and batching remains available and validated for any caller that opts in after measuring its own margins
the_conservative_remedy_not_taken_autono.cost: C3's causal scorer would lose the batching speedup it was designed around, which changes the C3 runtime and therefore the $25 envelope's arithmetic. That is a budget and design question, not an engineering one, which is why it is returned rather than decided here.
